newsitem.title: UK: Avocet says fwd gold sales underpin Penjom.
newsitem.headline: Avocet says fwd gold sales underpin Penjom.

text.p: Avocet Mining Plc, the international mining group, said on Wednesday that in view of the current gold price it confirms it has hedged sufficient gold to ensure profitable production from its Penjom mine in Malaysia for the next two years.
Its wholly owned unit Avocet Gold Ltd has, of today, sold 213,000 ounces of gold for delivery over the next two years at an average $382 per ounce.

"With state cash costs of less than $200 per ounce, these forward sales underpin the gold mine's profitability for the next two years from now, based on current production plans to produce at the rate of 100,000 ounces per annum," the company said in a statement.
Gold was fixed in London at a near 12-year low on Wednesday at $315.75 an ounce.
